alt: Lymphatic system anatomy - lymph capillaries → collecting vessels → trunks → ducts → veins. Thoracic duct drains everything below diaphragm + left upper body → left subclavian vein. Right lymphatic duct drains right upper body → right subclavian vein. Major node clusters: cervical, axillary, mediastinal, abdominal, pelvic, inguinal.
